cap: Late-pregnancy problems leave one recognizable signature on the fetus. Diabetes before conception, in weeks 3 to 8, causes malformations such as caudal regression, whereas gestational diabetes causes overgrowth. Early insults give symmetric growth restriction, and late placental insufficiency gives asymmetric, head-sparing restriction. Maternal bile acids raise stillbirth risk, and indomethacin can close the ductus arteriosus.
